title: Verdict: AcmeDB
take: the boring database that actually ships
summary: AcmeDB does one thing — durable key-value storage — and does it without an operator PhD. No consensus wizardry, no sharding astrology; just a WAL, a manifest, and docs that answer the question you actually asked.
bottom_line: Ship it behind a cache. Do not put your crown jewels in it.

sources.name: AcmeDB issue 412 — cross-region replication
sources.quote: Cross-region replication is on the roadmap.

sources.name: AcmeDB launch post
sources.quote: p99 read latency under 2ms on a laptop.
